raw_segments.text: Clarence. Ah, keeper, keeper, I have done these things that now give evidence against
my soul, for Edward's sake, and see how he requites me. Oh God, if my deep prayers
cannot appease thee, but thou wilt be avenged on my misdeeds, yet execute thy wrath in
me alone. Oh, spare my guiltless wife and my poor children. Keeper, I prithee sit by
me a while. My soul is heavy, and I fain would sleep.
